newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Gadek buys fund management company stake.
newsitem.headline: Gadek buys fund management company stake.

text.p: Malaysian financial and automotive group Gadek (Malaysia) Bhd said on Tuesday it had acquired a 60 percent stake in an asset management company.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Gadek said it would acquire the stake in Gadek Asset Management Sdn Bhd, which has a paid up capital of two million ringgit.
Gadek said the acquisition would have a "synergistic effect on Gadek's existing business".
Gadek currently owns a substantial stake in financial services firm Gadek Capital Bhd.
